evidence.summary: process_run is an available process_grant effect with typed request/result contracts.
Forge still launches verifier/compiler helper processes through its Python Runner.
Two-argument process_run(request, envelope) is rejected with MNP216.

reproduction.instructions: Revalidate against the current Profile 0.18 source/runtime and exact focused Forge reproducer.

summary: The historical claim that MNCS has no process spawning/capture/exit status is stale at Profile 0.18. mncs.std.process.v1 and process_run expose explicit argv, bounded environment, stdin/stdout/stderr, deadline, and exit status. Forge has not migrated verifier execution to this effect because aggregate cgroup limits and cancellable running handles are absent; the bounded Python Runner remains the consumer realization.

workaround.description: Forge continues to use the existing bounded host Runner for process realization while native semantic migration proceeds.
